p.s: Nowadays many students have a part-time job for their colleges' tuition.
So it's going to be a problem because we have to do it especially private school.
I think it is important for us however there are many shortages.
First, we are student.
The most important part to us is study.
The chance of part-time job is always around you however the chance of study is not around you.
For instance, there is someone who has started studying late.
They thought part-time job is more important than study but they realized that study have to do in proper time.
Therefore part-time job is not important than study.
Second, we cannot concentrate on class.
Generally, we usually do part-time job from the evening to the late at night.
Therefore we cannot concentrate our class because of sleepiness.
For example, I did night delivery service from 10.00pm to 6.00am.
It is so hard in the first day, but I adapted to the environmental change so I slept during classes.
Therefore part-time job disturb the concentration on class.
Consequently, part-time job is become the social problem.
Many news castings report it as the social problem.
So the Government adopts a wise policy to concentrate study.
The problem only can resolve from the Government because it's a hot potato for college students.
We have to study for our future and part-time job is not the first.
